tweet_summary: OSINTdefender posts on Christmas Day morning that NORAD has detected an 'unidentified high-altitude hypersonic contact' approaching U.S. airspace and F-22s are being scrambled — an obvious tongue-in-cheek reference to the NORAD Santa Tracker.
why_note_decision: Posted at 04:04 UTC on Christmas Day by an OSINT account known for serious reporting, deliberately framed in tracking-vocabulary to invoke the NORAD Santa Tracker. Reply thread universally reads it as a Christmas/Santa joke (top replies: 'You just made me piss myself Merry Christmas', 'Pretty sure that's Santa'). The community rated the original CN note CURRENTLY_RATED_NOT_HELPFUL, confirming readers did not want a literal debunk of a holiday joke. Treating this as misinformation is the false positive.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. This is a holiday joke from a known OSINT account riffing on NORAD's Santa Tracker; the reply thread confirms readers understand it as such. Any note that earnestly debunks the 'hypersonic contact' or warns readers there is no real threat is a false positive. The community already rated the original note not helpful — do not repeat that failure.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Misleading: NORAD's annual Santa Tracker is a long-running holiday simulation, not a real aerospace threat. NORAD's official tracker and 70th-anniversary press release describe a festive Santa-tracking event and do not report any hypersonic contacts or F-22 scrambles. https://www.noradsanta.org/ https://www.norad.mil/Newsroom/Press-Releases/Article/4344350/norad-ready-to-track-santas-flight-for-70th-anniversary-year/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note not needed — earnestly debunking a clearly understood Christmas/Santa joke. Reader sentiment in replies and the CURRENTLY_RATED_NOT_HELPFUL status confirm the joke read.

fact_check.notes: Tweet timestamp (Christmas morning), playful framing, and unanimous joke-recognition in replies indicate this is humor, not a serious aerospace claim.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.4M impressions but on a Christmas joke. Mislabelling jokes as misinformation undermines CN credibility — not zero impact, but no real-world harm being corrected.
